description: Writes a CV into whatever param the mouse is over, so a knob or switch with no CV input of its own can be modulated

params.text: Picks when the module writes into the param under the mouse: always on on, only with shift held on w/shift, or never on off, where it starts, despite the manual saying it defaults to w/shift
Sets the range the input voltage is read over before it is mapped onto the hovered param's own range: -5/+5, 0/+10 or -10/+10, which it starts on; voltage beyond the chosen range is clamped

inputs.text: The voltage written into the param under the mouse, mapped from the range set by INPUT RANGE onto that param's lowest and highest values

notes: params on Inject Value itself are skipped, so its own switches cannot be driven this way.
VALUE shows the value about to be written, and MIN, MAX and DEFAULT the hovered param's lowest, highest and default values.
a switch fed a continuously varying voltage lands between its positions, and some modules misbehave on a value that is not one of the expected ones.
the value is written at the screen refresh rate, around 60 times a second, rather than at the audio rate.
the module comes up with its enable switch at off and writes nothing until that switch is moved to on or to w/shift
with the switch at w/shift, a value is written only while a shift key is held down
